title: 第788章 击杀在此处第787章 吃尽了苦头
slug: 别人听劝仿明星你开局扮神明
content_zh:
，，！
而在远方的战场之上，诸多道场的弟子们看到这一切，全都神情振奋无比，心中激荡。
甚至忍不住大吼了起来，激动之情难以言表。
「杀了他，彻底将他击杀在此处！
」「真的可以击碎周天星斗大阵吗？真的可以将周天星斗大阵凝聚出的那道身影留在此处了！
」就是一些修为最高深的弟子，就算是一些平时再冷静的弟子，看到这一切也忍不住了，有些颤抖，嘴唇都哆唆了。
望着远方的一切，只觉得一股热血直冲脑门，几乎要长啸而起。
眼前发生的这一切，实在让他们太过震撼、太过激动了。
一道又一道流光在苍天之上旋转，弥漫着最为绚烂的光芒。
周天星斗大阵凝聚出的身影是谁？传说中最为古老的存在！
就算是上古时代都没有人可以是他的对手！
那是天庭的神仙！
上古天庭妖族用来对付巫族的最高兵器。
是传说中的东皇太一与帝俊凝聚出来的神物！
千万年来从来没有人能够认清周天星斗大阵的一切方式！
没有人可以想像它的攻击神通！
它是千变万化的，它是无敌的！
古老的岁月在天地之间流转，周天星斗大阵数万年来从来没有被破解过，没有被击溃过！
尤其是周天星斗大阵凝聚出的那道身影！
更是从未有过战败的痕迹！

哪怕是上古时代那个最为艰难的古老岁月，他都没有什么落败的迹象！
他曾经在最为古老的战场之上，纵横天地之间，杀得日月无光、天地失色！
他是当初覆灭妖族的罪魁祸首，他给妖族带来的伤害实在太庞大了！
他的力量，真的称得上是绝对的主宰！
真的称得上是不败！
昔日时光中，周天星斗大阵凝聚出的那道身影真的是无敌的！
content_en:
,,!
On the battlefield in the distance, the disciples in many dojos saw all this, and they were all very excited and their hearts were agitated.
He even couldn't help shouting, his excitement was beyond words.
"Kill him, kill him here completely!
"Can we really destroy the Zhoutian Xingdou Formation? Can we really keep the figure condensed from the Zhoutian Xingdou Formation here!"
"Even some of the disciples with the most advanced cultivation, even those who are usually calm, couldn't help it when they saw all this. They trembled a little and their lips trembled.
Looking at everything in the distance, I felt a rush of blood rushing straight to my forehead, almost screaming.
Everything that happened before their eyes really shocked and excited them.
Stream after stream of light swirled in the sky, filled with the most brilliant light.
Who is the figure condensed in the Zhoutian Xingdou array? The oldest existence in legend!
Even in ancient times, no one can be his opponent!
That's a god from heaven!
The highest weapon used by the ancient demon clan in heaven to deal with the witch clan.
It is a divine object condensed by the legendary Donghuang Taiyi and Dijun!
In thousands of years, no one has been able to understand all the ways of the Zhoutian Star Formation!
No one can imagine its magical attack power!
It is ever-changing and invincible!
The ancient years have flowed between heaven and earth, and the Zhoutian Star Formation has never been cracked or defeated for tens of thousands of years!
Especially the figure condensed by the Zhoutian Starry Formation!
There has never been any sign of defeat!
Even in the most difficult ancient years of the ancient times, he showed no signs of defeat!
He once fought on the most ancient battlefield, across the sky and the earth, and killed the sun and the moon until the sun and the moon eclipsed the light of the sky and the earth!
He was the culprit who destroyed the Demon Clan in the first place, and the damage he caused to the Demon Clan was too great!
His power can truly be called an absolute master!
It can really be called undefeated!
In the past, the figure condensed by the Zhoutian Starry Formation was truly invincible!
